text:
Rashid M: Quick sync needed - partners keep asking how to escalate HW faults into SEV workflows during marketplace onboarding. We should define a simple handshake + minimal audit trail.
Clara P: Agreed. Proposal: a 2-channel pattern: private `#partner-<org>-sev` + transient public `#partner-bridge` for cross-partner issues. Private channel must be invite-only for partners with compliance requirements.
Victor L: Keep it minimal: triage flow = 1) post issue in private channel (5m ack expected) 2) run `!collect` to gather logs (bot uploads to secure bucket) 3) if P1, `!escalate P1` triggers warroom creation.
ops-bot: Template created: `/partner init <org> --sev --private --pin runbook-template`
Nora S: For auditing/legal: each partner channel should have NDA flag and retention policy pinned. We also need to record who pressed `!escalate` (audit entry) and attach the partner-runbook id.
Clara P: Also include a short pager policy: partner success or AE pages SRE for non-blockers; direct SRE page allowed for verified P1s only. We keep a signed pager whitelist in the runbook.
Victor L: Technical detail: bot `!collect` should run: `tar -cz /var/log/redwood/* | curl -F file=@- https://uploads.redwood/incoming?partner=<org>&token=<handshake_token>` Handshake token is per-channel and rotates monthly.
Rashid M: Good. Need to ensure handshake tokens are scoped and stored in HSM. Also include a small verification step when someone tries to page: bot checks token + pager whitelist.
Nora S: I'll work with Legal to add the NDA & retention metadata to the channel template. Also will draft a 3-line notice for invite-only partners that explains what can/cannot be posted. ETA Tue.
Clara P: Warroom template should include: incident link, warroom call URL, oncall list, partner contact, evidence link, and post-incident owner. Keep it as a pinned JSON snippet so automation can parse it.
Victor L: Example `!escalate` sequence: 1) user `!escalate P1 reason` 2) bot validates NDA & pager 3) bot creates `warroom-<org>-<inc>` 4) bot posts call list and assigns incident owner 5) bot opens a ticket in Pager system. Manual override command: `!escalate P1 --force`.
Rashid M: For fallback routing: if hosted inference is degraded, bot can post `AUTOFALLBACK` notice and call ops endpoint: `POST /ops/fallback?partner=<org>&to=dedicated` — only allowed if partner has Dedicated provisioning. Include expected delta and rollback steps in message.
Nora S: Confirm: retention of artifacts = 90 days for non-compliant partners, longer only if contract permits. I'll output the NDA checklist to the runbook.
Clara P: Action items: Nora 1 NDA + retention flags (Tue EOD); Victor 1 bot `!collect` + `!escalate` prototype (Thu); Rashid 1 fallback toggle + HSM token plan (Thu); Clara 1 channel template + pinned runbook JSON (Wed). I'll schedule a 25m check-in Wed 4pm PT.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2025-11-05T16:00:00Z to review templates.
Victor L: I'll post a short demo video of `!escalate` flow once prototype lands.
Rashid M: If we can get agreements from the first two partners, roll this as the marketplace SEV beta. Keep the automation optional at first.
Clara P: Sounds good. No objections from my side.
Nora S: I'll start the NDA outreach after lunch.
Rashid M: Thanks everyone. Let's keep the runbook parsable and automation-friendly.
